reason: A DSH companion plugin that integrates Trellis workflow state, active-task context, subagent coordination, lifecycle-aware commands, and profile configuration into DeepSeek Harness sessions.

summaries.zh: 将 Trellis 工作流状态、任务上下文和子代理生命周期协调能力集成到 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的可选插件。
summaries.en: An optional DeepSeek Harness plugin that integrates Trellis workflow state, task context, subagent coordination, and lifecycle-aware commands.

capabilities: Injects Trellis workflow state and active-task context into agent sessions
Coordinates native background subagents and waits for lifecycle settlement events
Provides explicit status and finish commands using workflow and git state
Reads and writes plugin configuration through DSH profile settings
Passes managed session identity and configuration to plugin subprocesses
